envelope.tactical_move: Dispatch formal demand to force commission involvement
envelope.state_change_precondition: No demand for investigation into the burning has reached the commission
envelope.state_change: The player seals and dispatches the letter to the commission
envelope.forces_choice: forces the player to choose between monitoring the commission's response or pursuing independent leads
envelope.branch_a: Monitor the commission's response closely for any summons
envelope.branch_b: Pursue independent leads while the commission deliberates
envelope.scene_purpose: Show the player visibly sending the sealed demand as the initiating action

event_slots.exit_state: the demand for investigation has been sent to the commission
